versions.content: dataReadAccess vs. dataReceivePointByValue or dataReceivePointByArgument As opposed to the dataReadAccess : • Using the dataReceivePointByValue or dataReceivePointByArgument , the RunnableEntity always “receives” the latest value of the dataElement fore each call to the respective API during the execution of the RunnableEn- tity . • When using a dataReadAccess , the value of the respective dataElement is received before the RunnableEntity starts and does not change during the execution of the RunnableEntity independently of the number of API calls for implicit reception. • The presence of a dataReceivePointByValue or dataReceivePointB- yArgument per definition lets the corresponding RunnableEntity attain cat. 1B.
